# Class: `ConcentrationAxis`

Formats concentration ticks on a logarithmic plot axis.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-plot.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_plot.py#L189) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `pg.AxisItem`.

Chooses decade spacing from the visible span and available height, with intermediate ticks where space permits. Adjusts tick labels without changing plotted concentrations.
